meta.title: DIAN e-invoicing: simulator
meta.description: E-invoicing simulator for Colombia with sample data: issue invoices, credit and debit notes and POS equivalent documents; validate the NIT check digit, compute VAT per rate and generate a sample CUFE, QR code, PDF and XML. Includes RADIAN events for supplier invoices and exportable ledgers. Nothing is sent to the DIAN.

header.simBadge: Simulation: nothing is sent to the DIAN
header.resetConfirm: Discard your changes and go back to the sample data?
header.storageFull: Your browser has no room to save your changes (a very large logo?). The demo still works, but it won't remember them after a reload.

hero.title: DIAN e-invoicing from your own system
hero.subtitle: Issue invoices, credit and debit notes and POS equivalent documents; download the PDF with its QR code and the XML; answer your suppliers' invoices with RADIAN events and export the period ledgers.
hero.simNote: Everything runs in your browser with fictitious companies and figures. Signing, transmission and DIAN validation are simulated, and your changes are stored only on this device.

note.helpCredit: In Colombia an accepted invoice is never deleted or edited: it is corrected with a credit note that references it and stays linked to it.
note.helpDebit: A debit note increases the value of an invoice already issued (interest, charges or value changes) and stays linked to it.
note.fullVoid: The whole invoice is credited ({total}). The invoice is not deleted: this credit note brings its balance to zero.
note.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. three training hours not delivered

pos.help: Electronic equivalent document for point-of-sale sales. If the buyer asks for the document with their details, enter them.

phases.deliver: PDF and XML delivered to the buyer (simulated)
phases.failed: The DIAN did not respond (simulated): queued for contingency

contingency.title: Contingency: what if the DIAN does not respond?
contingency.text: You keep invoicing: the document is generated and delivered to the customer, waits in a queue and is transmitted when the service is back, within the deadline set by the regulation.
contingency.tip: Try it: turn on the simulation, go to “Sales invoice” and issue; come back here and restore the service to transmit the queue.
contingency.toggleOn: Simulate that the DIAN is not responding
contingency.queueEmpty: No queued documents. Turn on the simulation and issue an invoice to see it here.

success.acceptedNoEmail: Hand it to the buyer printed or through the channel you prefer.
success.queuedSub: You can already hand it to the customer; it will be transmitted when you restore the service in the Contingency tab.
success.cufeNote: Computed in your browser with the DIAN technical annex formula, fictitious data and a sample technical key (test environment). The QR code is real: scan it to see its data.

reception.title: Supplier invoices (RADIAN)
reception.subtitle: Your suppliers' invoices arrive as XML with their PDF. Validate them and register the RADIAN events in order: acknowledgment, receipt of goods or services, and acceptance or claim.

checks.nit: Supplier NIT with valid check digit

reception.suggestClaim: This invoice is not addressed to your NIT: the right move is to claim it with reason 01.
reception.note: Simulated: in your project the events are registered with the DIAN through the technology provider, and invoices arrive in the reception mailbox.

reports.title: Ledgers and reports
reports.subtitle: Computed from the documents in this simulation. Download them as CSV (opens in Excel) or PDF.

notes.sales: Invoices, POS documents and debit notes add up; credit notes subtract. Rejected documents are excluded.
notes.purchases: Supplier invoices in the period; claimed ones are excluded.
notes.vat: Estimated summary to review with your accountant; it does not replace the tax return.
notes.withholding: Withholdings your customers would apply according to the reference rates.

reports.pdfSample: Sample data from the KopTup simulator. Not an official report.

api.title: API to connect your system
api.subtitle: This is how your e-commerce, ERP or POS integrates: your system sends the sale and receives the status by webhook. This API is built in your project; it is not a public service available today.
api.live: The request is built from what you have in the issuing form.

project.title: What gets built in your project
project.subtitle: What this demo simulates and how it works in production.

provider.title: Transmission to the DIAN
provider.text: Through a partner authorized technology provider or your own software enabled with the DIAN. KopTup is not an authorized technology provider.

signature.title: Digital signature
signature.text: With your company's signing certificate or the technology provider's.

integration.title: Integration with your system
integration.text: Your e-commerce, ERP, POS or healthcare software issues through the API, and your customer gets the PDF and XML by email or WhatsApp.

storage.title: Retention
storage.text: XML and PDF files are kept for the period required by Colombian regulations, with backups; storage and encryption are configured during implementation.

countries.title: Other countries
countries.text: Mexico, Peru and Chile are quoted separately (Advanced plan). This simulator shows Colombia only.
